object.attr: derived: CF-V50 (D-V33). Rebase, cherry-pick, revert and stash conflicts get no banner and are resolved in the client, where ours and theirs are swapped in a rebase. Needs the widened term Conflicting file.
object.description: While the git index holds a conflicting file in a document folder and no merge is in progress, the Project Explorer shall say that Mellon resolves merges only.
